description.value: Skookum Gear is a full-service bike and ski shop with locations in Revelstoke and Salmon Arm, stocking a broad range of mountain, road, gravel, and e-bikes from brands including Giant, Specialized, Liv, and Rocky Mountain Bicycles. The Revelstoke shop sits in one of BC's premier mountain-biking towns and runs a dedicated service department staffed by technicians with 10+ years of experience. Touring cyclists will find accessories ranging from panniers and hydration packs to lights, pumps, and tools alongside the full workshop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Skookum Gear is an active, full-service bike and outdoor shop with locations in Revelstoke and Salmon Arm, BC; the OSM coordinates (50.999°N, 118.195°W) place this record at the Revelstoke store on MacKenzie Avenue. The /pages/service subpage explicitly describes a full bike service operation with multiple experienced technicians and comprehensive repair capabilities ('You Betcha, we can fix that!'). The main site navigation lists 'Panniers & bags' under accessories, confirming at least one touring-relevant product category is stocked.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but Revelstoke is in the Columbia-Shuswap region, not the Okanagan & Thompson; geographic categorization may need correction.
No phone number present in OSM tags or recoverable from the (truncated) website contact page.
OSM address lacks city name; appended 'Revelstoke, BC' based on coordinates and website header, but not confirmed from a contact page address field.
OSM tags the shop as shop=sports rather than shop=bicycle; website confirms cycling is a primary focus so category is appropriate, but the OSM tag mismatch is noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bike shop with confirmed service department in Revelstoke — highly relevant to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists two store locations (Revelstoke and Salmon Arm); this OSM record corresponds to the Revelstoke location based on coordinates. A separate OSM record may exist or be needed for the Salmon Arm location.
